title: More Metals & Precious Minerals
description: A mod that adds 12 new ores into the game, with all their tools and armors.
body:

### Description:
Have you ever felt that there is a lack of ores in the game? Like, do you sometimes wish caves had a wider variety of resources beyond what they currently have? Specifically, more ores or metals to make more sets of tools like pickaxes, shovels, etc., including swords, or to simply cave resources that fulfill other functions like new light-sources or even a new source of food? 

Well, if you have, you will enjoy this mod, for every single one of these new 12 ores have different functions, some of them every time you craft a tool or a piece of armor, they already have a specific set of enchantments, others give you a new fuel source to substitute coal or even the colorful "_Candy Crystals_", that when you break them, they will give Candy gems that you can eat and convert into the "_Jawbreaker_" food, which will grant you haste and speed.  

If you're a tiny bit curious to know more about the mod, then how about you enter the wiki to see the bunch of new sets of armors, tools, blocks, and even the new Shield that this mod adds.

And if it convinced you, I hope you truly enjoy downloading it for your next world.
